Package com.example.eventflow.model.entities

Class Event

java.lang.Object
com.example.eventflow.model.entities.Event
public class Event extends Object
Domain model representing a single event within the application. This class stores details about the event, its registration periods, capacity, and manages the lists of entrants (waiting, selected, rejected). It also handles geolocation requirements and private event status.

  • Constructor Details

    • Event

      public Event()
      Required no-arg constructor for Firestore deserialization. Initializes lists and sets default values for geolocation and privacy.

    • Event

      public Event(String eventId, String name, String description, String location, com.google.firebase.Timestamp eventDate, com.google.firebase.Timestamp registrationStart, com.google.firebase.Timestamp registrationEnd, String organizerId, int capacity, int waitingListLimit)
      Constructs a new Event with specified details.
      Parameters:
      eventId - Unique identifier for the event.
      name - Name of the event.
      description - Brief description of the event.
      location - Geographical location or venue name.
      eventDate - Date and time when the event occurs.
      registrationStart - Start of the registration period.
      registrationEnd - End of the registration period.
      organizerId - ID of the user who organized the event.
      capacity - Maximum number of attendees.
      waitingListLimit - Maximum number of people allowed on the waiting list.
